messages:
riya: Noticing a burst of 5xxs from embeddings between 21:05-21:18 UTC, traced to migration sidecar hang. Need a fast hotpatch: restart worker + flip MIGRATION_MODE. Requesting expedited approval SRE+Product. Preferred change window 21:30-22:00 UTC. deploybot, intake please.

deploybot: Intake acknowledged for service=embeddings. Hotpatch proposal: image=redwood/embeds:2026-03-hotpatch-mig. Canary plan: 12% for 4m. Required approvers: @ash (SRE) + @mike (Product). Runbook + rollback required to proceed.

ash: Oncall SRE here. I need a rollback one-liner and abort thresholds. Also confirm smoke steps for staging.

riya: Short runbook: 1) Kick canary (12%, 4m). 2) Watch errors via /dash?svc=embeds&window=4m and logs for sidecar panics. Abort if errors >0.9% OR p95 increases >180ms. 3) Rollback command: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/embeds embeds=redwood/embeds:2026.03-stable && kubectl rollout status deploy/embeds`. 4) Post release note and notify customers.

mike: Product ack, no schema change. Draft release note: "Hotfix: restart embed worker and toggle migration flag to address intermittent 5xxs. No API changes."

ash: Ran staging smoke at 21:22 UTC, healthchecks ok, kv cache warm, sample inference latencies stable. Staging approved pending canary green.

deploybot: Manual gate created. To start: `/deploy kick 6443219999 --window 21:30-22:00 --manual-gate`. Approvals required: `/deploy approve 6443219999 --by @ash` and `/deploy approve 6443219999 --by @mike`.

riya: Kicking at 21:31 UTC. Canary id cb-6443219999. Initial canary metrics: errors=0.08%, p95 +20ms.

ash: Canary looks clean from SRE; no panics. `/deploy approve 6443219999 --by @ash`

mike: Approving from Product. `/deploy approve 6443219999 --by @mike`

deploybot: Both approvals recorded. Promoting to 100% at 21:36 UTC. Rolling update in progress.

deploybot: Rollout complete 21:38 UTC. Post-rollout metrics: errors ~0.07%, p95 within baseline. No rollback executed.

ops-lead: Ops monitoring bridge open for +30m. So far stable.

releasebot: Release note posted to internal docs: https://docs.internal/release-notes/2026-03-embed-migfix (draft).

riya: Thanks all. Will close thread after monitoring. If anything flares, we'll reopen and run rollback. :white_check_mark:
